status: Reviewable proposed offline input revision; NOT ACTIVATED, implemented or executable-frozen

source.identityPolicy: Explicit new publisher-state input version. Dated URL and captured MD5 pin expected contents; MD5 is a publisher integrity checksum, not a strong authenticity proof. Future acquisition must independently retain SHA256, source header/features/replication state and full raw file. Require exact bytes/MD5/header state; drift or missing identity stops with no latest/date fallback. Do not claim header timestamp is global all-object snapshot completeness. No PBF/header has been read yet.
source.license: OSM ODbL/attribution; preserve publisher/source provenance and raw missing editor metadata status.

resourceArithmetic.scope: Assigned caps/reserves, not predicted or measured working sizes, memory peaks or four-hour completion. Read-only local capacity is sufficient for these proposed limits at observation time; recheck before execution.

departuresFromOriginal.upstreamRows: New explicitly counted national scan stream; original250000 selected elements/500000 per-window occurrences and128MiB normalized caps remain. Four passes each <=1B nodes/100M ways/10M relations =4.44B maximum object visits. Index/byte/time caps may stop far earlier. No inferred count from file size.
departuresFromOriginal.sourceState: Proposed new publisher replication state replaces the old exact historical-time acquisition only for a separately versioned future run. Old source evidence/results/snapshot remain intact. Original source/matching/accuracy gates are not waived.

tools.runtimeDependency: requests and its transitives; resolve and freeze all exact wheels, versions, sizes, SHA256/URLs before any binary GET, maximum6 wheels total. No tests/docs extras, source builds, apt, arbitrary pip network resolution or image pull. If closure exceeds caps, stop for revised design.
tools.installation: Future isolated tool directory only: python3 -B -m pip install --no-index --no-deps --no-compile --target /tools/site /inputs/wheels/*.whl after every archived wheel hash and size is checked; immutable cached stdlib Python/SQLite. Read-only import/ABI/PBF tiny-fixture smoke test network=none before any PBF GET. No app/npm/environment modification.

networkPlan.counts: 1 dated MD5 +1 dated source listing +1 publisher polygon +1 Pyosmium metadata +<=6 dependency metadata +<=6 wheel GETs +1 PBF =<=17 requests. Stop if more packages/requests are needed. All exact paths/hashes are bound before corresponding requests; only one final PBF GET.
networkPlan.transport: One direct verified-TLS meter, identity encoding, no inherited proxy/cookie/auth, redirects/range/resume/retry or automatic source fallback. Byte/attempt ledgers before IO; bounded raw/error/partial spool. A new Linux trust path is proven for metadata only; synthetic full absolute deadlines/chunk/framing/certificate failures remain required. No credential mount or host trust changes.
networkPlan.phases: Owned acquisition worker bridge network, then owned extraction/audit worker network=none. Read-only image/code/source/tools, only owned outputs writable, --init/no pull/no env mount. One global wall interval including network/setup/four file scans/audit and cleanup; independent watchdog/host remaining-time bound. Code host/path allowlist is not an OS hostname firewall.

extraction.sourceFraming: Require OSM0.6/DenseNodes support; reject unknown required features/history/multiple versions, unsupported compression, malformed/truncated frames or missing identity. Guard BlobHeader<64KiB and decoded Blob<32MiB before admission; prove decoder/decompression behavior synthetically, with cgroup hard bound. No full XML conversion.
extraction.pass1: Scan complete file to EOF in verified type/ID order. Store every node ID and copied native coordinate in the primary capped SQLite index; duplicate/out-of-order ID or malformed/too-new record stops. For each highway way, copy bounded raw native fields/references, batch lookup all referenced coordinates, test every segment against every original bbox including inclusive boundary touches. Missing referenced geometry stops rather than calling a way outside. Select solely by segment intersection, without city/region/type/access shortcuts or node-inside requirement. Count all upstream nodes/ways/relations and every selected-window occurrence.
extraction.pass2: Rescan the same hash-bound file to recover complete native metadata/tags for each selected referenced node and selected way. Retain restriction relations with a typed member referring to a selected way or its full nodes, preserving all raw roles/members and unresolved external references; no recursive repair downloads or access inference. Check coordinates against pass1 index, ordered dependency identity, exact typed de-duplication/normalization prefixes and all21 complete-from-file window inventories.
extraction.auditPass3: Independently rebuild a second capped coordinate index from the same raw file and enumerate selected ways/typed memberships using a separate geometry/control implementation. Do not read primary selection/index results to seed the audit. Same Pyosmium decoder/SQLite and low-level native/hash primitives are explicitly shared, not independent source/physical verification.
extraction.auditPass4: Recover independent full selected-node/way/restriction metadata from raw input, compare complete selection sets, native fields, per-window counts, missing/external references, raw-file/node-dependent hashes and normalized output prefix. Retain both capped indexes and all failures; source identity and output admission require all4 EOF scans/audits/counters/limits to reconcile.
extraction.sqlite: Each newly owned derived index: page_size4096/max_page_count6291456/cache_size-131072/mmap_size0/temp_storeMEMORY/journal_modeOFF, read back every setting and test compile-option behavior. No WAL or unmetered temp/extra indexes. Cache is only a hint; 4GiB cgroup is the hard limit. OFF indexes may corrupt on error/crash; never trust/resume them, never roll back/reuse to claim success. Raw PBF and append-only failure ledgers stay preserved. Final index integrity check only on successful completed scans.
extraction.sourceBoundaryGate: Completion means complete extraction of the acquired publisher PBF, not all global OSM/physical roads. Before original source feasibility can be asserted, separately verify publisher clipping/polygon adequacy for every unchanged window and document unresolved outside-file competitors/cross-boundary dependencies. A polygon containing a window alone does not prove inclusion of every possible long crossing way. If source adequacy cannot be justified, keep original completeness gate unqualified even after successful extraction.
extraction.retainedSemantics: Preserve raw native version/timestamp/coordinates/all tags and missingness/ordered node references/typed restriction roles. No speed units/defaults/access/direction interpretation, Overture adapter, matcher, graph or ETA/model run.
extraction.hashIoScope: Four passes count native-object decoding, not every filesystem read. Download MD5/SHA256 are incremental. Additional immutable-file hash checks/framing reads must be metered separately and included in the same four-hour wall bound; no four-pass throughput/performance forecast is claimed.

acceptance: This stage passes on a reviewable proposal and capacity/arithmetic/synthetic reasoning. Later execution only after tool closure/native framing/geometry/index/storage/timeout/resource tests pass and a separate exact code/dependency/input/query/resource recipe is frozen. Data capture success requires bytes/MD5/new SHA256/header state, four complete scans, all21 acquired-file-complete ledgers, independent audit/limits/cleanup. Still no original source feasibility, usable limits, physical identity or model admission.
failure: Retain every attempted metadata/tool/raw/error/partial file, capped index and normalized prefix, scan/window outcomes and source/counter/state/resource/cleanup ledger. No overwrite/resume/retry/latest/mirror/raised-cap fallback or deletion of failed evidence. Hard kill/OOM/SQLite integrity failure marks indexes/output untrusted; counter partialness explicit. A correction requires a separately versioned design/run.
deferred: Native speed/access adapter/parser/matching,50% usable-limit screen/independent match review,all83/35 accuracy/physical/package/memory/startup/API/visual gates, national model integration and any app/UI/env/DB/npm/Vercel/commit/push/deploy change.
